name: Default
shortDescription: Collaborative decision-making for groups: threaded discussions, proposals, polls and votes, with a background job worker, PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Sign-in works through emailed login links, so set SMTP_SERVER, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD and SUPPORT_EMAIL before the first sign-up. For STARTTLS on port 587, set SMTP_PORT to 587 and leave SMTP_USE_SSL empty. NOTIFICATIONS_EMAIL_ADDRESS must be a sender your SMTP server accepts.
No account is an admin by default. After your first sign-in, run rails runner 'User.last.update!(is_admin: true)' in the loomio container to open /admin.
HTTPS is required: Loomio forces secure cookies, so sign-in fails over plain HTTP.
